purpose: Make every study exercise understandable and actionable before a learner is asked to reason or code.
intakeRules: State the premise before asking any learner question.
A packet must be usable without assuming the learner remembers the source assignment.
Show at least one input/output example that explains the contract without revealing implementation code.
Let a correct slow solution count as a guided milestone when optimization is not part of the stated first goal.
Prefer executable feedback before algorithmic hints.
Reveal hints one level at a time and require another attempt before escalation.
Separate documentation lookup for language/API facts from exact-solution lookup.
A source repository remains authority for its behavior; StudySyndicate owns the pedagogical restatement.
Do not import secrets, client data, credentials, machine-specific identifiers, or sensitive operational evidence into study packets.

sourceRepositoryAdapter.output: a StudySyndicate problem packet that then supplies checkpoints, feedback, hints, and documentation guidance

uiGate.rule: The browser UI may now render proven packet mechanics, but it is a renderer of the canonical packet/harness contracts and may not invent, shorten away, or silently upgrade premise, feedback, mastery, or runner semantics.
proofSatisfied: guided packet behavior tests prove the premise appears before questions
checker failures identify specific repair classes without dumping the solution
graduated hints and official-documentation lookup are separately available
the operator successfully generated and used a self-contained Two Sum attempt from the harness
remainingBoundaries: language execution is capability-gated by harness/practice-workbench.v1.json
new source-repository exercises must pass the same premise-first intake contract
mastery proof remains stricter than guided or docs-assisted work
